result_text:
The default scoping now treats any folder whose name starts with `mock` or `__mock` as mock resources, at any depth and with either slash style. The codeanalyzer module tests pass (107 test classes, no failures or errors).

**Change**
- `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`: the two rules `.*/__mock[a-zA-Z0-9_\- ]+/.*` and `.*/mock[a-zA-Z0-9_\- ]+/.*` are replaced by one rule, `.*/(__)?mock[^/]*/.*`. The `[^/]*` part accepts any characters after the prefix, including punctuation, spaces and non-ASCII, and it also accepts an empty suffix, which is what makes plain `mock/` match. Windows paths are already normalised by `SourceFileFilter.pathMatches`.
- New test `codeanalyzer/src/test/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventionsMockTest.java`. It checks the new folder cases (`mock`, `mock.data`, `mock(old)`, `mock-größe`, `mock模拟`, a backslash path), the previously matched folders (`mocks`, `__mocks__`, `mock-data`, `mock_data`, `mock data`, `mockStore`), and the non-matches (`remock/`, `demo/`, `src/main/java/`, `mock.java`, `mockery.java`).

I left the existing `mockapi` rule and the `_mock.*` file rule alone, since they are unaffected by this change.

I did not commit anything.
